Utilities

Functions for writing results to file, for reading results from said file, and for plotting results.

utils.load_results(file_name='./results/results.csv')[source]

Load the results CSV and group rows by modified prior name.

Each row in the CSV represents one experiment run. The returned dict maps each unique value of the ‘Modified prior’ column to a DataFrame containing all runs for that prior, sorted by ‘New value of modified prior’.

Parameters:

file_name (str) – Path and file name of the results CSV.

Returns:

One DataFrame per modified prior name.

Return type:

dict[str, pd.DataFrame]

utils.match_to_grid(df, mod_var_name, scan_type)[source]

Subset a results DataFrame to rows whose modified-prior value falls on the predefined grid for the given scan type. Needed for the boxplot, which treats the x-axis as categorical.

Parameters:

  • df (pd.DataFrame) – Results for one modified prior (from load_results).

  • mod_var_name (str) – Name of the modified prior (e.g. ‘mu_X’).

  • scan_type (str) – ‘wide’ or ‘focused’.

Returns:

Filtered copy of df.

Return type:

pd.DataFrame

utils.plot_CATE_for_var(var, mean_of_x, std_of_x, x_label, file_name, x_lim, y_lim, scan)[source]
Parameters:

  • var (str) – Name of modified prior variable.

  • mean_of_x (float) – Mean of horizontal scale (x) to center on.

  • std_of_x (float) – Standard deviation of the horizontal scale (x). Used for normalizing plot.

  • x_label (str) – Label that will be visible under the x-axis.

  • file_name (str) – File name and path of the result file.

  • x_lim ((float, float)) – +-Limits of horizontal axis.

  • y_lim ((float, float)) – +-Limits of vertical axis.

Function for plotting CATEs.

Parameters:

file_name (str) – Path and name of result file.

Create all plots from the results file: separate CATE line plots, separate Y boxplots, and combined figures.

Parameters:

file_name (str) – Path and name of result file.

utils.plot_all_Y(file_name='./results/results_18_2.csv')[source]

Method for plotting all boxplots for outcomes Y under treatment selected based on beliefs.

Parameters:

file_name (str) – Path and name of result file.

utils.plot_all_cate_change(file_name='./results/results.csv', scan='')[source]

Create ΔCATE vs X_o plots for all modified prior variables.

Parameters:

  • file_name (str) – Path to the results CSV file.

  • scan (str) – Label used in output file names.

utils.plot_all_combined(file_name='./results/results_18_2.csv', scan='wide', scan_centers=None, scan_deviations=None)[source]

Create combined figures for all modified priors for one scan type.

Parameters:

  • file_name (str) – Path and name of result file.

  • scan (str) – ‘wide’ (default) or ‘focused’.

utils.plot_cate_change_for_var(df, variable_name, mean_x, std_x, x_label, scan='', misalignment_sds=(-5, 0, 5))[source]

Plot ΔCATE (posterior − prior) vs X_o for three levels of prior misalignment.

Selects the rows whose “New value of modified prior” is closest to mean_x + sd * std_x for each sd in misalignment_sds (~50 rows per level, covering the range of X_o values).

Parameters:

  • df (pd.DataFrame) – Results for one modified prior (from load_results).

  • variable_name (str) – Name of the modified prior.

  • mean_x (float) – True (aligned) value of the prior parameter.

  • std_x (float) – 1 SD unit for this parameter.

  • x_label (str) – X-axis label.

  • scan (str) – Label used in the output file name.

  • misalignment_sds (tuple) – SD offsets to plot (default −1, 0, +1).

utils.plot_combined_for_var(df, variable_name, mean_x, std_x, x_label, x_lim=None, y_lim_cate=None, max_boxes=30, threshold=5, scan='')[source]

Combined CATE line plot (top), E[Y|do(A)] line plot (middle), and Y outcome boxplot (bottom) with a shared continuous x-axis.

Parameters:

  • df (pd.DataFrame) – Results for one modified prior (from load_results).

  • variable_name (str) – Name of the modified prior, used in the output file name.

  • mean_x (float) – Center of the x-axis (for normalization). Pass None to skip normalization.

  • std_x (float) – Scale of the x-axis (for normalization). Pass None to skip normalization.

  • x_label (str) – Label for the shared x-axis.

  • x_lim ((float, float)) – Horizontal axis limits after normalization.

  • y_lim_cate ((float, float)) – Vertical axis limits for the CATE panel.

  • max_boxes (int) – Maximum number of x-positions in the boxplot.

  • threshold (float) – CATE threshold line drawn in the CATE panel.

  • scan (str) – Scan label used in the output file name.

Notes

The uncertainty bands are empirical-mixture standard deviations, combining the stored within-patient variance with variation between observed patients.

utils.plot_combined_grid(file_name='./results/results_18_2.csv', scan='wide', threshold=5, max_boxes=30, scan_centers=None, scan_deviations=None)[source]

Create a 3×3 grid figure for mu_X, mu_A, and N_E.

Columns correspond to the three variables; rows correspond to the CATE panel, the E[Y|do(A)] panel, and the Y outcome boxplot. Each row shares a common y-axis scale across all three variable columns.

Parameters:

  • file_name (str) – Path to the results CSV file.

  • scan (str) – ‘wide’ or ‘focused’; selects x-axis limits.

  • threshold (float) – CATE threshold line value.

  • max_boxes (int) – Maximum number of x-positions in the boxplot.

  • scan_centers (dict or None) – Optional mapping from prior name to (center, step). The historical no-intercept values are used when omitted.

  • scan_deviations (sequence or None) – Optional scan offsets used for x-axis limits.

utils.plot_dimensionality(file_name='./results/results_dimensionality.csv', scan_centers=None)[source]

Plot mean posterior CATE against covariate dimensionality.

Parameters:

  • file_name (str) – Consolidated dimensionality-results CSV.

  • scan_centers (dict or None) – Optional mapping from prior name to (center, step) used to label scan offsets.

utils.plot_dimensionality_improvement(file_name='./results/results_dimensionality.csv', scan_centers=None)[source]

Plot prior and posterior CATE against covariate dimensionality.

One panel is produced for every scanned value of each prior family.

Parameters:

  • file_name (str) – Consolidated dimensionality-results CSV.

  • scan_centers (dict or None) – Optional mapping from prior name to (center, step) used to label scan offsets.

utils.plot_prior_and_posterior_Y(df, variable_name, mean_x, std_x=None, xlim=(None, None), scan=None, keep_rate=None)[source]

Create side-by-side boxplots of prior and posterior Y outcomes.

Parameters:

  • df (pd.DataFrame) – Results for one modified prior (from match_to_grid).

  • variable_name (str) – Name of the modified prior (e.g. ‘mu_X’).

  • mean_x (float) – Mean of x for normalization.

  • std_x (float) – Standard deviation of x for normalization.

  • xlim ((float, float)) – +-Limits of horizontal axis after normalization.

  • scan (str) – ‘wide’ or ‘focused’.

  • keep_rate (int) – Keep every nth x-value to reduce clutter.

utils.write_results_to_file(result_dict, file_name='results.csv', path='./results/')[source]

Function for writing results to file.

Existing files must have exactly the same header as the row being appended. A schema mismatch raises ValueError instead of producing a malformed CSV.

Parameters:

  • [dict] (result_dict) – Dict of results to store.

  • file_name (str) – Name of file to write results to.

  • path (str) – Path where to store result file.
